patterns.skill_gap: None. The bars_state sandbox pre-builds frames, which made the legacy-probe branch load-bearing for suite-green compliance.
patterns.what_hard: The stale-pin collision: build points necessarily invalidate unconditional-build pins, and tests/ edits were outside the stated scope. Resolved by a minimal documented re-cut (2 specs + 1 block) rather than leaving the tree red or voiding HU-22.
patterns.what_worked: Gate-probe on a /tmp copy (enabled/has_weapon/built per hand per class) settled the fixture question empirically before choosing re-cut over bug-hunt.
